proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ A B C D E F hAB hCD hEF h1 h2
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
  have hn : F -ᵥ E ≠ 0 := vsub_ne_zero.mpr hEF.symm
  haveI : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 1 + 1) := ⟨Fact.out⟩
  have hfr : Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ {F -ᵥ E})ᗮ = 1 := Submodule.finrank_orthogonal_span_singleton hn
  have hu : B -ᵥ A ∈ (Submodule.span ℝ {F -ᵥ E})ᗮ := by
    rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_left]; exact h1
  have hv : D -ᵥ C ∈ (Submodule.span ℝ {F -ᵥ E})ᗮ := by
    rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_left]; exact h2
  have hu0 : (⟨B -ᵥ A, hu⟩ : (Submodule.span ℝ {F -ᵥ E})ᗮ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; exact hAB (vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq.mp (congrArg Subtype.val h)).symm
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' _ hu0).mp hfr ⟨D -ᵥ C, hv⟩
  have hc' : c • (B -ᵥ A) = D -ᵥ C := congrArg Subtype.val hc
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_smul] at hc'
    exact hCD (vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq.mp hc'.symm).symm
  rw [AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vectorSpan_pair_rev, ← hc']
  exact (Submodule.span_singleton_smul_eq (IsUnit.mk0 _ hc0) _).symm
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (A B C D E F : P), A ≠ B → C ≠ D → E ≠ F → inner ℝ (B -ᵥ A) (F -ᵥ E) = 0 → inner ℝ (D -ᵥ C) (F -ᵥ E) = 0 → (line[ℝ, A, B]).Parallel line[ℝ, C, D]
